content.text:
Here are good **U.S. online options** for ordering a birthday cake:

- **Goldbelly** — best for nationwide shipping from famous bakeries; good if you want something special or giftable. ([goldbelly.com](https://www.goldbelly.com/collections/best-birthday-cakes?utm_source=openai))  
- **Whole Foods Market** — good for local pickup or delivery; many stores let you order cakes online and personalize the message. ([wholefoodsmarket.com](https://www.wholefoodsmarket.com/departments/bakery/cakes?utm_source=openai))  
- **Costco** — good value for larger parties; availability/order process can vary by location, but Costco does offer some birthday cakes for delivery online. ([costco.com](https://www.costco.com/opt/birthday-cakes-for-delivery?utm_source=openai))  
- **Milk Bar** — popular for its signature birthday cake; ships nationwide via Goldbelly. ([goldbelly.com](https://www.goldbelly.com/restaurants/milk-bar/signature-birthday-cake?utm_source=openai))  
- **Instacart / DoorDash / Uber Eats** — often the fastest option for same-day cakes from local grocery stores or bakeries.  
- **Local bakery websites** — usually best for custom designs, dietary needs, and fresh pickup/delivery.

If you want the easiest pick: **Whole Foods for local pickup/delivery**, **Goldbelly for nationwide shipping**, or **Instacart/DoorDash for same-day**.
